[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Pora''' was the Second in Command of the security forces posted to the [[Technical Branch Outpost (Lotide)|Technical Branch Outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lotide]]. In reality, Pora was actually a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Internal Security Branch]] and was investigating [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hawra]] for corruption. Pora planned to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Hawra if the charges were proved.
